title: Strawberries Watercolor Clipart Bundle
author: TeesDesign
description:
Add a splash of sweet summer goodness to your creative projects with this vibrant watercolor strawberry clipart collection! Featuring beautifully hand-painted, juicy red strawberries in various delightful forms—whole berries, freshly sliced halves, sweet berries in a rustic glass jar, nestled in a woven basket, splashing in milk, and even topped with a dollop of fresh whipped cream. These high-quality, realistic botanical fruit illustrations are perfect for adding a fresh, mouth-watering aesthetic to your seasonal designs.
What You Will Receive:
✔️ 20 High-Quality Strawberry Clipart Images
✔️ PNG Format with Transparent Backgrounds
✔️ High Resolution 300 DPI Files
Perfect For:
✔️ Summer party invitations and greeting cards
✔️ Recipe cards, cookbooks, and food blogs
✔️ Sublimation on kitchen towels, mugs, and tumblers
✔️ Scrapbooking and summer-themed junk journals
✔️ Custom digital planners and cute sticker sheets
✔️ T-shirt designs and children’s summer apparel
✔️ Bakery branding and sweet treat packaging
